We Purify Our Water, Why Not Our Air? We eat organic food, drink filtered water and clean with anti-bacterial products. What about the air you and your family breathe? The fibers released from furniture, drapery, carpeting and clothing, drift and settle around the home each time they are touched. How Does an Air Purifier Work ? Air purifiers are designed to help remove airborne particles and odors from air passing through the filter. Using fans the dirty air is brought in through an intake grill The air then passes through filters helping to remove pollutants, allergens, and other contaminants from the Air your breathe. After the air is filtered, a fan distributes the clean air back into the room.
